dataset_specific_analysis.future_extension_assessment: Potentially useful as a future extension if shared diagnosis, age, region, year, or sex concepts can be validated. It should not be joined in this profiling stage.
risks: Different analytical grain may make direct comparisons invalid.
Indicators may have different semantics from infectious-disease case counts.
Hospitalization indicators must not be interpreted as treatment-effectiveness evidence without a proper study design.
Cross-table analysis can invite causal misinterpretation if not carefully scoped.
